remaining_concerns: Several of the strongest adverse items are clustered in the media-freedom and emergency-rule mechanisms, so the chapter remains skewed toward those domains.
Electoral evidence is still more about timetable, institutional distrust, and logistical weakness than about a fully observed or completed 2022 contest.
Positive reforms on disability and indigenous rights are real but are documented more strongly at the announcement/promulgation level than at the implementation or outcomes level.
Some press-freedom incidents remain only partially attributable to the presidency because provincial or non-state actors were involved.
